text: A linear map T on an n-dimensional space V acts on the one-dimensional top exterior power ⋀ⁿV as multiplication by the scalar ___.
explanation: ⋀ⁿT sends e₁ ∧ ⋯ ∧ eₙ to Te₁ ∧ ⋯ ∧ Teₙ = det(T)·(e₁ ∧ ⋯ ∧ eₙ). This is the coordinate-free definition of the determinant and instantly yields det(ST) = det(S)det(T).
